turns.question: What was our best week between Monday 17 August and Sunday 27 September 2026, and what did it bring in?
turns.answer: Your best week was Monday 21 September to Sunday 27 September 2026, with revenue (gross, non-cancelled orders) of EUR 3,387.25. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
